Stem cell stimulating drugs to enhance skin repair
Stem cell stimulating drugs to enhance skin repair

My lab does some stuff with this. The FDA has had a big crack down on "stem cell" skin creams. The problem with some of these is that the cells aren't viable. They are a pretty big waste and not cheap. The FDA beef is the claims they make, of course. Cell derivatives can be effectively utilized though. I can't go into too much detail, but I will say that they are very effective in healing and anti-aging treatments (for wrinkles and such) if they are properly utilized.
It sort of reminds me of the situation with supposed probiotics marketed. A lot of them contain no viable bacteria either.

See, I feel a bit conflicted because I wonder if it is similar to the cellular stuff where proper extraction of cell contents can pass on the benefits of (and sometimes do better than) live cells. I suppose there hasn't been much study into the benefits of the derivatives versus the live culture of probiotic bacteria. With stem cells (MSCs) the benefits we see are largely due to excretions of cytokines and growth factors that stimulate the regenerative immune response. I feel like it would differ with probiotics because a big part of the benefit is due to those cultures colonizing intestinal lining. It's a battle for space. It would be interesting too to see if there was an effective probiotic method of out feeding the good bacteria.
